note: Grammar Gap allowlist — implemented Ops no Compiled Definition emits (ADR 0105 § 7.3, ADR 0137). SHRINK-ONLY: a row leaves when its emitting grammar rule lands; a new Op never enters. Verified offline by `bun run check:gaps`, which runs in `health` only. Seeded at issue #3824 with the 87 Ops never-emitted that day, each pointing at PRD issue #3820 until `gaps:sync` files its own; each row now names its own issue, a child of the Op-gap umbrella issue #3972 (issue #3829).
claimsNote: Stable keys, one scheme per `kind` (issue #3869; `gaps:sync` is the only writer). grammar — `opGapKey(op)`, i.e. `(op) › <op>`; an `ops` row IS a grammar claim, its kind implied by the array it sits in. mechanic / scenario — `quarantineClass(reason).key`, i.e. `<reason kind> › <detail minus the card prefix>`. bot — the Bot Gap form (issue #3830; the sweep is not built, so no row exists yet). hand-tail — the card's lockfile name. migration — the graduates' slot signature: the distinct `CardRow.slots` sorted and joined with ` + `, or `(no slot)`. No key may contain a tab or a newline — `claimId` joins kind and key on a tab, and `parseClaimRows` reds on one. `parseClaimRows` / `parseClaims` (scripts/lib/targets.ts) are the readers; the Coverage Invariant reads back grammar / mechanic / scenario / hand-tail only — a `bot` or `migration` row is validated and then ignored, because it settles no Target card's state. A row is never pruned: its issue stays open, and dropping the row would re-file it the day the gap comes back; `gaps:sync` reports such a row instead.
